question.problem: What is the root of the function $f(x)=2-4x?$
question.worked_solution:
The roots are the solutions to the equation $f(x)=0,$ which we solve as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =0 \\ 2-4x & =0 \\ 4x & =2 \\ x & =\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the function has the single root $x=\dfrac12.$
